apply_min_size: resize a sample dict with image, disparity, and mask to ensure minimum dimensions while keeping aspect ratio
Resize_class: resize image samples to a target width and height with optional aspect ratio preservation and multiple-of constraints
Resize_get_size: compute the output width and height for a given input size using lower_bound, upper_bound, or minimal resize methods
NormalizeImage_class: normalize an image sample by subtracting a mean and dividing by a standard deviation value
PrepareForNet_class: prepare a sample dict for network input by transposing image channels and casting arrays to float32
